Who I Am

I am Asia Parveen, a final-year BS Mathematics student at the Centre for Advanced Studies in Pure and Applied Mathematics (CASPAM), Bahauddin Zakariya University, Multan — driven by an insatiable curiosity for numbers, patterns, and the stories data tells.

Detail-oriented and motivated, I bring a strong foundation in analytical thinking, problem-solving, and quantitative methods. I possess hands-on knowledge of data analysis tools including Microsoft Excel, Python, and statistical concepts.

Highly interested in data-driven decision making, machine learning fundamentals, and business analytics. I am eager to apply mathematical and computational skills in real-world projects and continuously enhance expertise in technology-driven environments.

From earning 1st Position at BZU to leading the Caspam Welfare Council as Vice President and completing an internship at MCB Bank — I bring both academic excellence and real-world impact.
